AP3150 RGB Panel — APKINA

A slim 10W RGB panel with a 4000mAh built-in battery, 360° colour adjustment and 21 lighting effects.

SPECIFICATIONS
Power: 10W
Built-in battery: 4000mAh, 3.7V
Colour temperature: 2500–9900K, adjustable
Colour adjustment: 0–360° full colour gamut
Lighting effects: 21
Luminous flux: 1000 lm
Beam angle: 120°
Lighting distance: 3–5m
LED beads: 135
Weight: 250g
Dimensions: 151 × 79 × 11mm
Shell material: Aluminium alloy + PC

PACKAGING

Packing quantity: 40 pieces
